title: UPS Scheme Registry entry
description: One payment (or explicitly non-payment) QR/address format recognized by Universal Payment QR. Generated from the live Rust core's own scheme metadata by scripts/generate-registry.mjs - never hand-edited. See registry/README.md for field-by-field semantics and how this maps to the runtime PaymentIntent schema.

scheme.description: Stable machine id. Matches PaymentIntent.scheme in the runtime API exactly - this is the join key between the registry and a live parse result.

displayName.description: Human-readable name, e.g. "PromptPay" or "SEPA / EPC QR (Girocode)".

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes this scheme is issued in. Empty for schemes with no single issuing country (e.g. generic EMVCo MPM, or global crypto/link schemes).

standard.description: The named specification or governing document this scheme implements, e.g. "UPI deep link v1" or "EPC069-12 v2.1".

parserVersion.description: The universal-payment-qr-core crate version whose parser produced this entry (semver).

maturity.description: stable: original 6 schemes, no known open questions. beta: structure, checksum, and at least one confirmed real-world identifying detail verified against an official or independently cross-validated source. community: the national standard is confirmed real and EMVCo-based, but no scheme-specific GUID has been pinned down yet - detected via country tag only. experimental: recognized by shape/prefix only, or a structural detail could not be fully confirmed against a primary source.

identification.description: How confidently a match actually identifies THIS scheme, as opposed to a family it belongs to. exact: a scheme-specific signature (confirmed GUID, verified checksum algorithm, or a scheme-unique URI/domain) positively identifies this exact standard - corresponds to the runtime PaymentIntent.identification value GUID_MATCH for the EMVCo family. generic: matched via a shared envelope plus a weaker signal (e.g. generic EMVCo plus a country tag) that cannot rule out an unrelated standard from the same family/country - corresponds to runtime COUNTRY_LEVEL_INFERENCE. heuristic: matched by shape or prefix only, with no structural or checksum verification (proprietary formats with no public spec, or an invoice prefix check) - the runtime does not yet attach an explicit identification value outside the EMVCo family, so this is the registry's own equivalent tier.

supported.description: False only for schemes that are detected but never fully parsed because no public payload specification exists (Alipay, WeChat Pay) - matches the runtime PaymentIntent.supported / PROPRIETARY_FORMAT behavior for these two.

nonPayment.description: True for the 3 entries that are deliberately not payment schemes (WalletConnect pairing, otpauth:// 2FA setup, generic URL) but are still identified by name rather than falling into an "unknown" bucket.

lastVerified.description: The date this entry was last regenerated from, and cross-checked against, the live parser and its test suite - not necessarily the date the scheme was first implemented (see the repository's CHANGELOG.md and git history for that).

amount.description: The wire format has a field for a specific transfer amount.

merchant.description: The wire format has a field for a recipient/merchant/beneficiary name.

currency.description: The wire format has an explicit currency field (as opposed to an implied one, e.g. a crypto network's native asset).

dynamic.description: The scheme supports a dynamic QR - one that resolves the actual payment details from a URL/reference at scan time, rather than encoding them statically in the payload.

references.description: Public source(s) - an official spec, a central bank/scheme-operator document, or (for a confirmed-proprietary format) the operator's own site - this entry's identification method was verified against.
